content: flextable 0.10.0 (CRAN, 2026-07-07): 13 hard imports (data.table, gdtools, graphics, grDevices, grid, htmltools, knitr, officer, ragg, rlang, rmarkdown, stats, utils, uuid, xml2). ~57 total dependencies. Supports HTML, Word, PowerPoint, RTF, PDF via rmarkdown/Quarto. No LaTeX output. Best for Word document tables via officer. For academic PDF/LaTeX workflows, flextable falls short. Good Suggests candidate for Word-output scenarios but heavy dependency weight.
